Diagnostic keeps same consumer transaction, native XID and actual public identities; explicit validator GUCs and force_generic_plan set locally. No indexes/statistics changes or disabled/deferred-trigger flush.

limitations: Forced generic plan selection is deliberate, not a measurement of actual production PL/pgSQL cached-plan choice or CI behavior.
Ten100-operation attempts and fresh unanalysed relation statistics do not reproduce one1024-attempt shape or retained production history.
EXPLAIN adds profiling/cache effects and excludes PL/pgSQL record assignment, authority checks and remaining validation loops. No whole-validator hotspot attribution or CREATE/UPDATE speed inference.

Effective GUCs are established by executed SET statements, not separately SHOW-recorded; only target transition/attempt statistics and transition index definitions are recorded. Installed function prosrc/module provenance was not separately retained. These constrain attribution but do not invalidate the captured exact-query plans.
No speed, release, complete workload or capacity qualification, and no query/index rewrite is supported by these results.
reviewer_actions: Read-only script/source/raw JSON/log comparison and receipt write. No product edits, native/build/test execution or agents.
